---
title: "International Partnerships"
---

ÇAHSPAR builds strong international partnerships with public bodies, universities and civil society organisations to develop effective solutions in working life and social policy. Partnerships are an important way of creating value and extending the reach of the association’s work.

## Our Partnership Approach

- Collaboration with academic institutions in different countries
- Strategic dialogue and project development with public bodies
- Joint action with civil society organisations
- Collaborative efforts to increase stakeholder participation

## Areas of Collaboration

- Working with international research networks
- Developing and delivering cross-border projects
- Policy dialogue and sharing good practice
- Joint capacity-building programmes

## Current Partnerships

**18 October 2026**

### [ESD Conference – Ankara, 29–30 May 2027](https://www.esd-conference.com/)

Preparations have begun for the international conference “Sustainable Societies and Social Policy: Pathways for Just and Inclusive Futures”, to be held in Ankara on 29–30 May 2027 as part of the ESD Conference (International Scientific Conference Economic and Social Development) series and the association’s international partnerships. The conference proceedings are to be indexed in Web of Science (WoS). Further details will be shared shortly.
